# gdrive_permission (Resource)

One direct permission. Existing grants must be imported. Inherited grants cannot be managed here; unrelated ACL entries are never replaced.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gdrive_permission" "engineering" {
  file_id       = "SHARED_DRIVE_ID"
  type          = "group"
  email_address = "engineering@example.com"
  role          = "writer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_id` (String) File, folder, or Shared Drive ID.
- `role` (String) Drive API role. Ownership transfer is not supported.
- `type` (String) Principal type.

### Optional

- `allow_file_discovery` (Boolean) Allow discovery for domain or anyone grants.
- `domain` (String) Lowercase domain for a domain grant.
- `email_address` (String) Canonical lowercase user or group email.
- `send_notification_email` (Boolean) Send an email on creation of a user or group grant. Changing this does not resend an email.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Google Drive resource ID.
- `permission_id` (String) Google Drive resource ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import gdrive_permission.engineering 'SHARED_DRIVE_ID/PERMISSION_ID'
```
